objectives: A hirar neman aiki, amsa tambayoyin hira da aka saba yi kamar "Tell me about yourself" da gajerun amsoshin da kuka shirya, da jimloli 2 zuwa 4 a sarari kowace, da misali ɗaya na gaske daga aikinku ko rayuwarku

Idan aka ba ku kalmomin tsaro, alamomi da gargaɗin da aka saba gani a wurin aiki, faɗin ma'anar kowanne da abin da za a yi, da ba da rahoton haɗari ko rauni ga babban wurin aiki, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai, kuma kuna ba da rahoto nan take
Idan aka ba ku umarnin da ba ku fahimta sosai ba, neman taimakon babban wurin aiki ko abokin aiki, da maimaita umarnin don tabbatar da shi, kafin ku fara aikin

Idan aka ba ku jadawalin aiki ko shirinku ya canja, karanta lokutan aikinku da sanar da babban wurin aiki cewa za ku makara, ba ku da lafiya, ko kuna buƙatar hutu, kuna faɗin ranar, lokacin da dalilin, da wuri yadda za ku iya

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Samun aiki da zama lafiya

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Hirar neman aiki: amsa tambayoyin da aka saba yi
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Amsa tambayoyin hira uku da aka saba yi da gajerun amsoshin da kuka shirya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A hirar neman aiki, za ku iya amsa tambayoyin hira da aka saba yi kamar "Tell me about yourself" da gajerun amsoshin da kuka shirya, da jimloli 2 zuwa 4 a sarari kowace, da misali ɗaya na gaske daga aikinku ko rayuwarku.
Yawancin hirar neman aiki suna farawa da 'yan tambayoyi iri ɗaya. Kuna iya shirya amsoshinku ku yi atisayensu da babbar murya. Gajerun amsoshi masu sarari sun fi dogaye kyau.
"Tell me about yourself." (Ka/Ki faɗa mini game da kanka.) Ku amsa da batun aikinku, ba rayuwarku ta sirri ba: "I have three years of experience in a restaurant kitchen. I am fast and careful. I want to grow in food service." "Why do you want this job?" (Me yasa kake son wannan aikin?) Amsa: "I like working with my hands, and this company has good training." "When can you start?" (Yaushe za ka iya farawa?) Amsa: "I can start next Monday."
Wasu tambayoyin da aka saba yi: "What are your strengths?" ("I am on time and I learn fast.") "Can you work weekends?" ("Yes, I can work Saturdays.") A ƙarshe sukan tambaya "Do you have any questions?" Ku shirya tambaya ɗaya: "What does a normal day look like?" ko "What are the hours?"
Ƙwarewar aiki daga ƙasarku ta asali tana da daraja. Ku faɗe ta: "In Mexico I built houses for five years." Idan ba ku fahimci tambaya ba, ku yi amfani da kalmomin da kuka sani: "Sorry, can you repeat the question, please?"
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta gajerun amsoshi ga tambayoyin da aka saba yi.
- Ku yi amfani da misali ɗaya na gaske daga aikinku ko rayuwarku a kowace amsa.
- Ku yi atisaye da babbar murya har ku iya faɗinsu ba tare da karantawa ba.
- Ku shirya tambaya ɗaya da za ku yi a ƙarshe.
- Idan ba ku ji tambaya ba, ku roƙe su su maimaita ta.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Experience": aikin da kuka taɓa yi a baya (ƙwarewa).
- "Strengths": abubuwan da kuke yi da kyau.
- "Interview": ganawa inda mai ɗaukar aiki yake yi muku tambayoyi don ya yanke shawarar ɗaukar ku aiki.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USA Learns: kwasa-kwasan Turanci kyauta ga manya (Sacramento County Office of Education)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta amsoshinku ga "Tell me about yourself", "Why do you want this job?" da "When can you start?" don aikin da kuke so. Kowace amsa ta zama jimloli 2 zuwa 4. Ku karanta su da babbar murya sau uku, sannan ku roƙi abokin atisaye ya yi muku hira, ko ku naɗi muryarku kuna amsawa.
Yanzu za ku iya amsa tambayoyin hira da aka saba yi da gajerun amsoshin da kuka shirya, da yin tambaya a ƙarshen hirar aiki.

check.q: Mai hirar ya ce "Tell me about yourself." Wace ce amsa mafi kyau?
options: "I have two years of experience cleaning offices. I am careful and on time."
"I have three children and I like soccer and my favorite food is rice."
check.why: Tana magana game da aiki da ƙwarewa a gajerun jimloli masu sarari.

check.q: Mai hirar ya tambaya "Do you have any questions?" Wace ce amsa mai kyau?
options: "What does a normal day look like?"
check.why: Tambaya game da aikin tana nuna cewa kuna da sha'awa.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Kalmomin tsaro, alamomi da gargaɗi
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Faɗin ma'anar alamomin tsaro da gargaɗin da aka saba gani, da abin da za a yi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku kalmomin tsaro, alamomi da gargaɗin da aka saba gani a wurin aiki, za ku iya faɗin ma'anar kowanne da abin da za a yi, da ba da rahoton haɗari ko rauni ga babban wurin aiki, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai, kuma kuna ba da rahoto nan take.
Kalmomin tsaro su ne Turanci mafi muhimmanci a wurin aiki. Ku fara koyon su. Alamomi: "Danger" yana nufin babban haɗari da zai iya kashe ku ko ya ji muku rauni sosai. "Caution" ko "Warning" yana nufin ku yi hankali. "Exit" ita ce hanyar fita. "Authorized personnel only" yana nufin ma'aikatan da aka ba izini kaɗai ne za su iya shiga. "Wet floor" yana nufin ƙasa tana da santsi.
Gargaɗin baki gajere ne kuma da ƙarfi: "Watch out!" "Stop!" "Look out!" "Heads up!" (wani abu zai iya faɗowa ko ya nufo ku). Idan kun ji ɗaya, ku tsaya, ku duba, ku matsa daga haɗarin.
Kalmomin kayan kariya: "Wear your gloves." (Ku sa safar hannu.) "Put on your safety glasses." (Ku sa gilashin kariya.) "Hard hat" (hula mai ƙarfi ta kariya). "Safety vest" (riga mai haske don direbobi su gan ku). "Ear plugs" (abin toshe kunne). Mai ɗaukar aikinku zai horar da ku kan kayan aikinku. Idan ba ku fahimci horon ba, ku tambaya.
Misalin hira. Babban wurin aiki: "Heads up! Forklift coming." Ma'aikaci: "Okay!" (ya ja da baya). Babban wurin aiki: "Always wear your vest in this area." Ma'aikaci: "Yes. My vest, always in this area."
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Hazard": abin da zai iya ji muku rauni, kamar ƙasa mai ruwa ko injin da ke motsi (haɗari).
- "Danger": kalmar alama don babban haɗari da zai iya kashe ku ko ya ji muku rauni sosai.
- "Caution": kalmar alama da ke nufin ku yi hankali.
- "Protective equipment": kayan da ke kare ku, kamar safar hannu, gilashin kariya ko hula mai ƙarfi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- OSHA: Haƙƙoƙin ma'aikata (US Department of Labor)
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi katin kalmomin tsaro don aikin da kuke so: ku rubuta kalmomi ko alamomin tsaro biyar da za ku gani a can da ma'anar kowanne. Ku faɗi kowanne da babbar murya. Sannan ku roƙi abokin atisaye ya kira gargaɗi ("Watch out!" "Heads up!") yayin da kuke nuna abin da za ku yi.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin ma'anar alamomin tsaro, gargaɗi da kalmomin kayan kariya da aka saba gani, da abin da za ku yi idan kun ji gargaɗi.

check.q: Abokin aiki ya yi ihu "Heads up!" Me za ku yi?
options: Ku tsaya, ku duba, ku matsa daga abin da ke zuwa
Ku mayar da ihun "Heads up" ku tsaya a wurin
check.why: "Heads up!" yana nufin wani abu zai iya faɗowa ko ya nufo ku.

check.q: Wata ƙofa tana da alama: "Authorized personnel only". Me take nufi?
options: Ma'aikatan da aka ba izini kaɗai ne za su iya shiga
check.why: "Authorized personnel only" yana nufin kuna buƙatar izini kafin ku shiga.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Ba da rahoton matsala ko rauni
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Ba da rahoton haɗari ko rauni ga babban wurin aikinku nan take.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku kalmomin tsaro, alamomi da gargaɗin da aka saba gani a wurin aiki, za ku iya faɗin ma'anar kowanne da abin da za a yi, da ba da rahoton haɗari ko rauni ga babban wurin aiki, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai, kuma kuna ba da rahoto nan take.
Idan kun ga wani abu marar aminci, ku faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku nan take: "Excuse me, there is a problem. There is oil on the floor in aisle 4." "This machine is making a strange noise." "The ladder is broken."
Idan kun ji rauni, ko kaɗan ne, ku faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku a ranar: "I hurt my hand. I cut it on a box." "I hurt my back when I lifted that." Ku faɗi inda da lokacin: "It happened at 10 o'clock, at the loading dock." A lokacin gaggawa, ku kira 911.
A Amurka, OSHA (hukumar gwamnatin tarayya ta tsaro a wurin aiki) ta ce ma'aikata suna da haƙƙoƙi, ciki har da horon tsaro a harshen da suka fahimta, ba da rahoton rauni a wurin aiki, da neman a binciki wurin aiki marar aminci. Doka ta ce mai ɗaukar aikinku ba zai iya hukunta ku ba don amfani da waɗannan haƙƙoƙi. Ku duba osha.gov/workers don cikakken bayani.
Misalin hira. Ma'aikaci: "Excuse me, I need to report something. I slipped and hurt my knee." Babban wurin aiki: "When did it happen?" Ma'aikaci: "About ten minutes ago, near the freezer." Babban wurin aiki: "Okay, let's fill out a report."
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku ce "Excuse me, I need to report something."
- Ku faɗi abin da ba daidai ba: haɗarin ko raunin.
- Ku faɗi inda da lokacin da ya faru.
- Ku ba da rahoton rauni a ranar, ko ƙarami ne.
- A lokacin gaggawa, ku kira 911.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Report": faɗa wa mutumin da ya dace game da matsala (rahoto).
- "Injury": cutarwa a jikinku, kamar yanka, ƙuna ko ciwon baya (rauni).
- "Supervisor": mutumin da ke kula da aikinku (babban wurin aiki).
- OSHA: Occupational Safety and Health Administration, hukumar gwamnatin tarayyar Amurka ta tsaro a wurin aiki.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- OSHA: Haƙƙoƙin ma'aikata (US Department of Labor)
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye kawai: ku rubuta gajerun rahotanni biyu, ɗaya game da haɗari (misali ƙasa mai ruwa) ɗaya kuma game da ƙaramin rauni na ƙirƙira. Kowanne yana faɗin me, ina da yaushe. Ku faɗe su da babbar murya kamar kuna magana da babban wurin aikinku.
Yanzu za ku iya ba da rahoton haɗari ko rauni ga babban wurin aikinku, kuna faɗin me, ina da yaushe, da ambaton haƙƙoƙinku na tsaro na asali.

check.q: Kun ga tsani da ya karye a wurin aiki. Me za ku faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku?
options: Babu komai; wani zai gan shi
"Excuse me, the ladder in the back room is broken."
check.why: Faɗa wa babban wurin aiki me da ina yana ba shi damar gyara haɗarin kafin wani ya ji rauni.

check.q: Kun ɗan yanke yatsanku a wurin aiki. Yaushe za ku ba da rahoto?
check.why: Ku ba da rahoton kowane rauni na wurin aiki a ranar, ko ƙarami ne.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Kowace rana a wurin aiki

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Neman taimako da tabbatar da umarni
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Neman taimako da maimaita umarni kafin ku fara.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku umarnin da ba ku fahimta sosai ba, za ku iya neman taimakon babban wurin aiki ko abokin aiki, da maimaita umarnin don tabbatar da shi, kafin ku fara aikin.
A wurin aiki, kuskure zai iya ɓata lokaci, kuɗi ko tsaro. Koyaushe ya fi kyau ku tambaya da ku yi tsammani. Ma'aikata nagari suna yin tambayoyi.
Don neman taimako: "Excuse me, can you help me?" "Can you show me how to do this?" "Where do I put these boxes?" "What should I do next?" Idan ba ku fahimta ba: "Sorry, can you explain that again, more slowly?"
Kafin ku fara, ku maimaita umarnin: "So, first I clean the tables, then I fill the napkins?" ko "Okay, I put the blue boxes on shelf 3. Is that right?" Babban wurin aikinku zai ce "Yes" ko ya gyara.
Misalin hira. Babban wurin aiki: "Please restock aisle 7 and then break down the empty boxes." Ma'aikaci: "Okay. So, first I restock aisle 7, then I break down the boxes. Where do the boxes go?" Babban wurin aiki: "In the recycling by the back door." Ma'aikaci: "Got it. Thank you."
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku saurari dukan umarnin.
- Ku tambaya game da duk abin da ba ku fahimta ba.
- Ku maimaita matakan: "So, first ..., then ...?"
- Ku jira "Yes" kafin ku fara.
- Ku sake tambaya idan kun makale: "What should I do next?"
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Instruction": kalmomin da ke faɗa muku yadda ake yin aiki (umarni).
- "Show me": ka yi shi a gabana don in ga yadda ake yi.
- "Got it": gajeriyar hanyar faɗin "I understand" (na fahimta).
Gwada yanzu: Ku roƙi abokin atisaye ko wani a iyali ya ba ku umarni mai matakai uku da Turanci (misali yadda ake yin sanwic ko naɗe riga). Ku maimaita shi da "So, first ..., then ...?" kafin ku yi. Sannan ku musanya matsayi.
Yanzu za ku iya neman taimakon babban wurin aiki ko abokin aiki, da maimaita umarni don tabbatar da shi kafin ku fara.

check.q: Babban wurin aikinku ya ba da dogon umarni. Me za ku yi kafin ku fara?
options: Ku fara kuna fatan ya yi daidai
check.why: Maimaita matakan yana kama kuskure kafin ku fara.

check.q: Ba ku san yadda ake amfani da sabon injin ba. Me za ku ce?
options: "Can you show me how to do this?"
Babu komai; ku gwada shi duk da haka
check.why: "Can you show me?" yana neman taimako ta hanya mai aminci kuma a sarari.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Jadawali: lokutan aiki, makara, rashin lafiya da hutu
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Karanta lokutan aikinku da sanar da babban wurin aiki cewa za ku makara, ba ku da lafiya, ko kuna buƙatar hutu.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku jadawalin aiki ko shirinku ya canja, za ku iya karanta lokutan aikinku da sanar da babban wurin aiki cewa za ku makara, ba ku da lafiya, ko kuna buƙatar hutu, kuna faɗin ranar, lokacin da dalilin, da wuri yadda za ku iya.
Shift (lokacin aiki) shi ne lokacin da kuke aiki, misali "Monday, 7 a.m. to 3:30 p.m." "a.m." safe ne (kafin ƙarfe 12 na rana) "p.m." kuma rana zuwa dare ne. Jadawalinku zai iya rubuta "OFF" don ranakun da ba ku aiki.
Idan za ku makara, ku faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku kafin lokacin aikinku: "Hi, this is Carlos. I'm sorry, my bus is late. I will be about 20 minutes late." Idan ba ku da lafiya: "Hi, this is Carlos. I'm sick today and I can't come in. I'm sorry." Kowane mai ɗaukar aiki yana da nasa dokokin sanar da rashin zuwa, don haka ku duba littafin dokokinku (handbook) ko ku tambayi babban wurin aikinku yadda da lokacin da za ku sanar da su.
Don neman hutu, ku tambaya da wuri, ido da ido ko a rubuce: "Can I have Friday the 14th off? I have an appointment." Don musanya lokacin aiki da abokin aiki: "Can I switch shifts with Maria on Saturday?"
Misalin saƙon tes: "Hi Ms. Johnson, this is Carlos from the morning shift. I am sick today and cannot come in. I'm sorry. I will let you know about tomorrow."
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta jadawalinku: ranakun, lokacin farawa da lokacin gamawa.
- Makara ko rashin lafiya: ku faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku kafin lokacin aikinku.
- Ku faɗi ko ku wane ne, abin da ba daidai ba, da lokacin da za ku zo.
- Ku nemi hutu da wuri, kuma ku faɗi kwanan watan.
- Ku bi dokokin mai ɗaukar aikinku na sanar da rashin zuwa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Shift": awoyin da kuke aiki a rana ɗaya (lokacin aiki).
- "Call in sick": sanar da mai ɗaukar aikinku cewa ba ku da lafiya kuma ba za ku iya aiki ba.
- "Time off": ranakun da kuke neman kada ku yi aiki (hutu).
- "Switch shifts": musanya lokutan aiki da abokin aiki.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta saƙonni biyu ga babban wurin aiki mai sunan ƙirƙira: ɗaya don faɗin cewa za ku makara da minti 15, ɗaya kuma don sanar da cewa ba ku da lafiya. Kowanne yana faɗin ko ku wane ne, abin da ba daidai ba, da lokacin da za ku zo. Ku karanta su da babbar murya kamar kiran waya.
Yanzu za ku iya karanta lokutan aikinku, da faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku a sarari cewa za ku makara, ba ku da lafiya, ko kuna buƙatar hutu.

check.q: Jadawalinku ya ce "Tuesday 2 p.m. - 10 p.m." Yaushe za ku fara aiki?
check.why: "p.m." yana nufin rana ko dare, don haka 2 p.m. ƙarfe 2 na rana ne.

check.q: Motar bas ɗinku ta makara kuma ba za ku iso farkon lokacin aikinku ba. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku kafin lokacin aikinku ya fara
Ku yi shiru ku zo a makare
check.why: Faɗa wa babban wurin aikinku da wuri girmamawa ce kuma yana taimaka masa ya tsara.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Magana da kwastomomi
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Gaishe da kwastoma, tayin taimako, da kiran wani ma'aikaci idan ba za ku iya taimakawa ba.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kwastoma ya zo wurinku, za ku iya gaishe da kwastoman, tayin taimako, da kiran wani ma'aikaci idan ba za ku iya taimakawa ba, cikin ladabi kuma ba tare da yin tsammanin amsa ba.
Kwastomomi suna son ma'aikata masu fara'a da magana a sarari. Ku gaishe su: "Hi, welcome!" ko "Good morning." Ku yi tayin taimako: "Can I help you find something?" "What can I get for you?"
Idan kun san amsar, ku gajarta ta: "Yes, it's in aisle 9." "It comes with fries." Idan ba ku sani ba, kada ku taɓa yin tsammani. Ku ce: "Let me check for you." ko "One moment, please. I'll get my manager."
Idan kwastoma yana magana da sauri sosai: "Sorry, could you say that again, please?" Idan ransa ya ɓaci, ku natsu ku yi ladabi: "I'm sorry about that. Let me get someone who can help." Ku ƙare da: "Have a nice day!"
Misalin hira. Ma'aikaci: "Hi, welcome! Can I help you find something?" Kwastoma: "Do you have this jacket in a large?" Ma'aikaci: "Let me check for you. One moment, please." (ya duba) "Yes, here you go." Kwastoma: "Thanks!" Ma'aikaci: "You're welcome. Have a nice day!"
Mataki-mataki:
- Gaisuwa: "Hi, welcome!"
- Tayin taimako: "Can I help you find something?"
- Ku amsa a gajarce idan kun sani.
- Idan ba ku sani ba: "Let me check for you." ko ku kira manaja.
- Ƙarshe: "Have a nice day!"
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Customer": mutumin da ke saya ko amfani da abin da kasuwanci ke sayarwa (kwastoma).
- "Manager": mutumin da ke shugabancin shago ko ƙungiya (manaja).
- "Let me check": hanyar ladabi ta faɗin cewa za ku nemo amsar.
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku rubuta rubutun Turancin wurin aiki don aikin da kuke so: amsarku ga "Tell me about yourself", ƙarin amsoshin hira biyu, kalmomin tsaro uku da ma'anarsu, saƙon sanar da rashin lafiya ko makara, da kalmomi biyu don kwastoma ko neman taimakon abokin aiki. Ku yi atisayensa da babbar murya ko a wasan kwaikwayo, kuma ku naɗi muryarku idan za ku iya.
Yanzu za ku iya gaishe da kwastoma, tayin taimako, da kiran mutumin da ya dace idan ba ku san amsar ba.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Amsoshin hira Babu amsoshi, ko sun yi tsawo sosai, ko suna game da rayuwar sirri maimakon aiki. "Tell me about yourself" da ƙarin amsoshi biyu, kowace jimloli 2 zuwa 4 a sarari da misali ɗaya na gaske. Yana faɗinsu da babbar murya ba tare da karantawa ba, kuma ya ƙara tambayar da zai yi a ƙarshe. Kalmomin tsaro Ƙasa da kalmomi uku, ko ma'anonin ba daidai ba ne. Kalmomi ko alamomin tsaro uku na aikin, kowanne da ma'anarsa daidai. Yana kuma nuna yadda ake ba da rahoton haɗari ko rauni: me, ina da yaushe. Neman taimako Babu kalmar neman taimako, ko babu hanyar tabbatar da umarni. Kalma ɗaya don neman taimako da jimla ɗaya da ke maimaita umarni. Yana amfani da su daidai a wasan kwaikwayo da abokin atisaye. Saƙon makara ko rashin lafiya Babu ko wane ne shi, abin da ba daidai ba, ko lokacin da zai zo. Saƙo a sarari, mai ladabi, da suna, dalili da lokaci. Yana kuma lura da yadda mai ɗaukar aikinsa yake son a sanar da rashin zuwa (littafin dokoki ko babban wurin aiki). Kalmomin kwastoma Babu kalmomin kwastoma, ko kalmomin ba na ladabi ba ne. Gaisuwa tare da tayin taimako, da kalma don lokacin da ba ku sani ba. Yana kula da kwastoma mai ɓacin rai cikin ladabi a wasan kwaikwayo. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku yi atisayen wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: Kwastoma ya yi tambaya kuma ba ku san amsar ba. Me za ku ce?
check.why: Dubawa ko kiran manaja ladabi ne kuma yana ba kwastoman amsar da ta dace.

check.q: Kwastoma ya zo wurinku. Mene ne abu na farko mai kyau da za ku faɗa?
options: "Hi, welcome! Can I help you find something?"
check.why: Gaisuwa da tayin taimako suna fara hirar da kyau.
